comparison.objective: Collect five pens into a holder between two clock-button presses.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed grasping, transport, containment, and button pressing; no coaxial tool alignment, impact fracture, or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Correct start/collect/stop sequence, all pens supported in the holder, and robot release.
comparison.reason: Tests timed multi-object organization, unlike breaking HELICOIL tangs with a stabilized mandrel and recovering fragments.
